commands: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; elif [ -f backend/requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r backend/requirements.txt; else echo 'requirements.txt not found in . or backend/' && ls -la && exit 1; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ -d backend/app ]; then cd backend; fi; uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
